list.title: Ceiling Frame Installation and Drywall Attachment
list.hazard: Fall from unlocked ladder hinges, nail gun accidents
list.measure: Visual check of lock engagement, wear cut-resistant gloves and safety glasses

list.title: Main Piping Welding and Pump Installation in Mechanical Room
list.hazard: Fire from welding spatter, burst during pressure testing
list.measure: Assign fire watch, incremental pressurisation within 1.1x design pressure

list.title: Excavation and Backfilling for Drainage Systems
list.hazard: Explosion from underground utility damage, burial due to slope failure
list.measure: Utility detection combined with manual digging, maintain safe slope

list.title: Roof Urethane Waterproofing and Exterior Water-based Painting
list.hazard: Fall from roof edges, asphyxiation from solvent vapours
list.measure: Secure lifeline to safety harness, implement forced ventilation via fans

list.title: Exterior Wall Maintenance and High-elevation Equipment Installation
list.hazard: Fall due to rope failure, crushing by MEWPs (Rental)
list.measure: Install separate vertical lifelines, inspect over-travel prevention devices

list.title: System Scaffolding Installation and Dismantling for Exterior Work
list.hazard: Entire structure collapse, impact from falling components
list.measure: Install wall ties according to standards, establish ground exclusion zones

list.title: Rebar Processing and Crane Lifting Work
list.hazard: Material fall due to hitching gear failure, processing machine entanglement
list.measure: Follow 2-line hitching rules, use dedicated push sticks during processing

list.title: Slab and Beam Concrete Pouring Work
list.hazard: Pump truck tip-over, impact from hose detachment and whipping
list.measure: Reinforce outrigger ground, inspect connection pins and rings

list.title: Demolition of Old Low-rise Structures and Waste Removal
list.hazard: Sudden collapse during demolition, risk of asbestos exposure
list.measure: Follow Top-down demolition principle, verify pre-demolition asbestos survey

list.title: Ceiling Electrical Wiring and Fire Safety Equipment Installation
list.hazard: Electric shock from live parts, fall due to body over-extension on ladders
list.measure: Implement panel LOTO, verify zero voltage with detector
